about: Places where a step takes you somewhere else on the same map: a portal between two floors of one building. The game tells an addon where you are on the map and never how high, and such a portal moves you a few yards across the map and a long way up or down - so the map has to know of it to follow you through (viewer/js/height.js). 'from' is where the game's own trigger is (its AreaTrigger table: world.json has them all, with their radius) and 'to' is where it puts you down, which the game's files do not say: the server decides. Each entry is one way; a portal that works both ways is two.
